page.layout: One page of text, running head at top with page number at right; a woodcut ornament in the middle of the page; faint show-through text from the reverse side in the right and left margins, not transcribed.

main_text.p: tuam bilem ἀνεφηλον expleres, paucu-lis paginis esses complexus: quem-admodum ex sequentibus manife-stum fiet.

page.notes: The Greek word in the first line is printed in italic Greek type; it is transcribed as best read ("ἀνεφηλον" is uncertain, [?]). A woodcut ornament (decorative triangular strapwork device) stands below the text and is not transcribed. Show-through from the facing page appears faintly and is omitted.
